title: The Life Cycle of a Massive Activation: Stochastic Birth, Weight-Decay-Driven Growth, and Competitive Consolidation
abstract: arXiv:2610.00423v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Massive activations, residual-stream coordinates with magnitudes far larger than typical activations, are associated with attention sinks in transformers, but how their scale is regulated during training remains incompletely understood. Combining training-trajectory analyses and controlled interventions, we trace their emergence, growth, and consolidation. Sink-carrying channels vary across random seeds but stabilize early within each run. Over longer training, surrounding channels erode and the sink concentrates onto a few redundant carriers. Across ablations, gradient attenuation follows the sink token's collective root-mean-square magnitude rather than any single channel, making collective scale central to understanding their effects. Our central result is that weight decay causally controls the turnover of global activation scale. translated_title: 大规模激活的生命周期：随机诞生、权重衰减驱动的增长与竞争性巩固
translated_abstract: 大规模激活（massive activations）是指幅度远超典型激活值的残差流坐标，它们与Transformer中的注意力陷阱相关联，但其规模在训练过程中如何被调控仍尚不完全清楚。结合训练轨迹分析与受控干预，我们追踪了它们的出现、增长与巩固过程。携带陷阱的通道在不同的随机种子之间各不相同，但在单次训练运行中会较早地稳定下来。随着训练的持续进行，周围的通道逐渐被侵蚀，陷阱集中到少数冗余载体上。在各项消融实验中，梯度衰减遵循的是陷阱词元的集体均方根幅度而非任何单一通道，这使得集体尺度成为理解其效应的核心。我们的核心结论是：权重衰减因果性地控制着全局激活规模的更替。在受控的继续训练中，在峰值附近移除衰减会使这一规模持续上升，而重新引入衰减则……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 该论文首次完整刻画了大规模激活的生命周期——陷阱通道随机诞生并早期稳定，权重衰减因果性地驱动全局激活规模的更替，最终陷阱通过竞争集中到少数冗余通道上完成巩固。
en_tdlr: This paper traces the full life cycle of massive activations: sink channels are born stochastically and stabilize early, weight decay causally governs the turnover of global activation scale, and the sink competitively consolidates onto a few redundant carrier channels over training.
